sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: springsteenlyrics.com, Brucebase, brucespringsteen.it: a cell whose title is shown in MusicBrainz style (its tip "As written on the site") now shows its findings above that tip. Before, the tip hid them: the lyrics index's Title cell of "Backstreets" was tinted for double-encoded text, but its card showed only the site's title.

Comparison cards: a text that differs from the other only in letter case ("BACKSTREETS" and "Backstreets") is marked letter by letter, with the summary "10 letters in a different case", instead of "The two share little, so nothing is marked".

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Brucebase and springsteenlyrics.com: six findings that compare two texts now show them as the diff card, like the venue one (the two values one under the other, the letters that differ marked), instead of a sentence: "Brucebase page named differently from its show" and "… titled differently from its show" (on the cells and on a show's own head marks; a show with several such pages gets one pair each, a title pair names its page), "Brucebase event page adds (Early), (Late), …" (the year heading over the event page's name), "Brucebase event page links another entry" (both anchors as year#anchor), "Brucebase entry with a comma after its date" (the entry over its usual form) and "Double-encoded text" on springsteenlyrics.com (each garbled text over what it means). The plain text stays the fallback.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Brucebase: "the venue's own page names it differently" (⚠️ on a year table's Venue cell, after ▶ Pages) no longer flags the wiki's own conventions: today's name on the venue page ("ICC Berlin, West Berlin, West Germany" for "ICC Berlin, Berlin, Germany"), the generic "Unknown Location" page, a room or part named before the venue ("Spotify HQ, Adelphi (The), London, England"), and a description between the venue and a place of more than two parts ("Concert Hall, QPAC, South Brisbane, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia"). The same rules as BruceParser 0.41.0's venue report: on the Brucebase run of 2026-11-23 both flag the same 104 events (128 with the old rules on the run of 2026-11-21), among them MetLife ×12 and the Telegraph Hill recordings that link the Holmdel residence.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Brucebase: "Brucebase page named differently from its show" (⚠️ ⇋) also covers a show's On stage, Off stage and soundcheck pages, as the Brucebase feed of BruceParser 0.40.0 lists them (76 pages, e.g. onstage:1988-05-06-tacoma-dome-tacoma-wa under gig:1988-05-06-dome-tacoma-wa). These pages have no breadcrumb, so their show is the one show of their date; a day with several shows is left out. The show is marked on its rows, head and window, the page itself on its rows, as for a Gallery or Notes page. Only the finding's description and its report text change here; the marks come from the feed.
